files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 [project] kind api-service and entry-point main.jac; this backend slice needs no npm or AI dependencies.

Define reference graph fields exactly: Event(year:int, month:int, day:int, hour:int, minute:int, title:str, description:str, work_min:int, break_min:int, cycles:int), Session(event_id:str, phase:str, cycle_ix:int, running:bool, phase_started_at:str ISO timestamp, phase_elapsed_before_pause:int), and Settings(idle_text:str). Implement now_iso() -> str, create_event, start_pomodoro, advance_phase, get_settings and set_idle_text using these fields. Starting a session marks prior active sessions phase done/running false. A two-cycle event advances work[0] to break[0] to work[1] to done. Keep public endpoints callable without an AI model.

signatures.create_event: def:pub create_event(year: int, month: int, day: int, hour: int, minute: int, title: str, description: str, work_min: int, break_min: int, cycles: int) -> Event

files.purpose: Import the public timer and settings endpoints from endpoints.jac so the API service registers them at startup; no browser client or JSX.

verify.steps: Run Jac check on main.jac and behavior tests on endpoints.jac. Independently check that a new session retires the prior one, two cycles alternate phases, and settings persist. Replay actual harness calls from a clean workspace.

assumption: This is a scoped adaptation of the Rui/pomodoro backend at Jac 0.36.1. The reference pins 0.36.0; the same endpoints.jac passed check and three behavior tests after isolated config migration to 0.36.1.
